workstreams.title: Calendar / habits / money integrated preview
workstreams.frontier: Calendar integration dependencies are reconciled: Finance/Auth and P4 are both software-ready through isolated served canaries and are now stopped only by their physical/human gates. Calendar itself retains separate worker-soluble durability/migration/UI backlog, which should continue as Calendar product work without reopening Finance/Capture architecture.

workstreams.title: Finance / private auth integration
workstreams.frontier: Software preparation is complete through an isolated served Finance/Auth canary. Stop at the real physical second-device/email gate; after PASS, verify missing-session fallback in-browser and then execute only the minimal Mercado Pago provider/auth probe plus reconciliation.

workstreams.title: P4 Capture integration
workstreams.frontier: R10 worker-soluble historical recovery and candidate feature restitution are complete: Universal Input value was recovered into the single P4 owner, tested, published to the isolated canary and made durable in Recovery/Return/Delta. Do not regenerate the old plan or continue with another shell. The next truthful frontier is physical microphone/device evidence, human UX acceptance and optional explicit export approval.

workstreams.title: PageKit / Class Player / whiteboard R07 recovery
workstreams.frontier: R07 recovery is closed. Durable authority-aware capability/regression, QA and negative-knowledge evidence now separates V26 stable rollback behavior, V37 selective candidate gains and Psicoanálisis PageKit consumer/whiteboard semantics. Future work belongs to existing product owners and promotion gates.
workstreams.last_useful_delta: R07 proved pressed-only eraser across V26/V37/Psico, preserved V26 as the stable rollback donor, classified V37 multi-board/object plus typed-undo and laser/object behavior as selective candidate gains, rejected unsupported Wacom pressure/button and application Fullscreen claims, and kept Psico sheet semantics/consumer authority separate from Class Player lineage.
depends_on: Input Ownership/Focus Lease if a future shared interaction implementation is attempted

workstreams.frontier: R09 durable public recovery is complete for currently accessible evidence. Future work resumes from LAST_RETURN + RECOVERY and only crosses into product mutation or private assets when authority/authorization justifies it.
workstreams.last_useful_delta: Recovered and persisted ordering, exact public heart/QR anchors, current visual/animation/viewer/publication contracts, publication lineage, privacy boundary and negative knowledge; filter selector and explicit artwork zoom remain UNRESOLVED rather than fabricated.

workstreams.title: R1-B Architecture Recovery
workstreams.frontier: R02 material recovery is complete. Reopen only for a concrete defect/request owned by an existing scoped architecture owner, or if exact historical R1-B source bytes are newly recovered.
workstreams.last_useful_delta: R1-B is now a durable adoption/invariant/routing map rather than a competing architecture: Part 2 tested-candidate owners and later P3 release evidence were reconciled, negative knowledge was preserved, and chat-only 74-file / CP-001..500 claims were kept unpromoted.

workstreams.title: R1-C contrast / falsification / negative-knowledge recovery
workstreams.frontier: R03 recovery exhausted at the available evidence ceiling. Reopen only to reconcile authentic original AMP-1/AMP-2 artifacts or when a current owner needs one of the recovered guardrails applied to material work.
workstreams.last_useful_delta: Recovered R1-C AMP-1/AMP-2 contrast and falsification knowledge into a registered workstream, a provenance/evidence-ceiling recovery file, a normalized 18-entry negative-knowledge register and a durable LAST_RETURN; reconciled all recovered rules against current authority and resolved a transient Agent Network write-scope collision by narrowing R1-C to its own directory.
provides: R1-C evidence ceiling and anti-fabrication guardrails
